verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry is a fair privacy question for a SaaS compliance and security platform like Oneleet, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents telemetry collection, usage tracking, or any opt-out control. The MCP OAuth scoping, RBAC and service-key scopes items are adjacent access controls, not telemetry opt-out, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
